import pytest
from PIL import Image
from smolagents.memory import ActionStep, ChatMessage, MessageRole, Timing

def test_action_step_to_messages_no_tool_calls():
    # No tool calls (empty list)
    step = ActionStep(
        model_input_messages=[ChatMessage(role=MessageRole.USER, content="Hello")],
        tool_calls=[],  # empty list
        timing=Timing(start_time=0.0, end_time=1.0),
        step_number=1,
        error=None,
        model_output_message=ChatMessage(role=MessageRole.ASSISTANT, content="Hi"),
        model_output="Hi",
        observations="obs",
        observations_images=[Image.new("RGB", (10,10))],
        action_output=None,
        token_usage=None,
    )
    messages = step.to_messages()
    # Should not contain any TOOL_CALL role message
    assert all(m.role != MessageRole.TOOL_CALL for m in messages)
    # Still should have assistant, observation, image messages (total 3)
    assert len(messages) == 3
